section_summary: This section contains U.S. State Department and SCAP records concerning regulations and applications for entry and travel into and exit from occupied Japan between August 1946 and February 1947. Key items include SCAP Circular No. 8 governing travel procedures for individuals, aircraft, and surface vessels, along with related State Department instructions. The documents also cover individual entry and exit cases, including Irish missionary sisters, the repatriation of a Brazilian-Japanese family, Swiss diplomatic arrangements, and Soviet objections to the exclusion of an Orthodox Church representative.

subfiles.about: Circular instruction outlining State Department handling of entry applications to Japan for countries without representation in Tokyo.
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP Circular No. 8 and explains that the Department will forward travel applications for unrepresented governments.
subfiles.title: Foreign Service Serial No. 667: Representation by the United States of Foreign Interests in Japan

subfiles.about: Internal routing memorandum transmitting SCAP Circular No. 8 regarding control of entry and exit for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Forwards SCAP Circular No. 8 concerning entry and exit control pursuant to a telephone conversation.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum forwarding SCAP Circular No. 8

subfiles.about: Comprehensive SCAP regulations establishing procedures and clearance controls for individuals, aircraft, and maritime vessels entering and departing Japan.
subfiles.from: General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This circular rescinds Circular 3 and establishes detailed entry and exit regulations for occupied Japan. It designates the Eighth Army, Commander Naval Activities Japan, and Pacific Air Command as implementing agencies for land, sea, and air controls. It details application procedures, documentation, customs, and health immunization requirements for civilian travelers, aircraft, and surface vessels.
subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Control of Entry and Exit of Individuals, Aircraft and Surface Vessels Into and From Japan

subfiles.about: Diplomatic note supporting an application for five Irish Sisters of Drishane Convent to enter Japan for educational and missionary work.
subfiles.summary: Transmits and supports Drishane Convent's request for entry permits for five Irish missionary sisters traveling to Japan.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note requesting Entry Permits for Irish Missionary Sisters

subfiles.about: Application detailing the background, itinerary, and missionary assignment in Japan for five Catholic sisters of the Sisters of Saint Maur.
subfiles.summary: Requests urgent entry permits for five sisters to teach in Japanese schools, attaching applicant particulars.
subfiles.title: Letter applying for Entry Permits for Five Missionary Sisters

subfiles.about: File memorandum summarizing coordination with the Irish Legation and Military Permit Secretariat regarding clearance for Irish sisters.
subfiles.summary: Records coordination with the Irish Legation regarding the addition of Joan Twomey, travel dates, health requirements, and housing assurances.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files regarding Entry Applications for Irish Sisters

subfiles.about: File memorandum recording background clearance checks conducted within State Department divisions for six Irish sisters.
subfiles.summary: Notes that background checks across State Department divisions revealed no derogatory information concerning the six Irish sisters.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Files regarding Name Checks on Irish Sisters

subfiles.about: Memorandum recording phone call from Mr. Skentlberry providing the Mother Provincial's address and confirmation of Irish nationality.
subfiles.summary: Records details from Mr. Skentlberry confirming Irish nationality, religious names, and Mother St. Genevieve's address in Tokyo.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Telephone Conversation on Irish Sisters' Entry Details

subfiles.about: Official State Department request transmitting Irish Legation's application for six sisters to proceed to Japan.
subfiles.from: Albert E. Clattenburg, Jr., Chief, Special Projects Division
subfiles.summary: Formally requests clearance from SCAP via the Joint Chiefs of Staff for six Irish sisters sailing February 21.
subfiles.title: Letter requesting Entry Clearance for Six Irish Sisters
subfiles.to: Commander John R. Millett, USN, Military Secretary to the Joint Chiefs of Staff

subfiles.about: Department of State reply regarding entry clearance and transit visa requirements for six Irish missionary sisters.
subfiles.summary: Informs the Irish Minister that the permit inquiry was referred to military authorities and advises applying for transit visas.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note to Irish Minister regarding Travel to Japan

subfiles.about: Internal routing note discussing procedural routines for handling transit through the United States to occupied areas.
subfiles.summary: Advises Miss Wolberg on procedural adjustments for handling transit travel through the United States to occupied territory.
subfiles.title: Handwritten Routing Note to Miss Wolberg

subfiles.about: Initial draft letter transmitting Irish Legation application for five sisters to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
subfiles.from: Albert E. Clattenburg, Jr., Chief, Special Projects Division
subfiles.summary: Earlier draft letter to Commander Millett concerning entry clearance for the initial group of five sisters.
subfiles.title: Draft Letter to Commander Millett regarding Irish Sisters

subfiles.about: Second draft letter to Commander Millett requesting military permit consideration for five Irish missionary sisters.
subfiles.from: Albert E. Clattenburg, Jr., Chief, Special Projects Division
subfiles.summary: Redrafted version of letter to Commander Millett incorporating visa division coordination prior to adding the sixth sister.
subfiles.title: Revised Draft Letter to Commander Millett regarding Irish Sisters

subfiles.about: Preliminary draft acknowledgment note to the Irish Legation concerning entry permission for five sisters.
subfiles.summary: Early draft acknowledging the Irish Legation's note and stating that inquiries are being addressed to appropriate authorities.
subfiles.title: Draft Note to Minister of Ireland

subfiles.about: Form designating an attached copy of Despatch No. 58 from São Paulo as the permanent central record copy.
subfiles.summary: Administrative form designating attached despatch copy as official record copy replacing missing action copy.
subfiles.title: Record Copy Replacement Form for Despatch No. 58

subfiles.about: Inquiry reporting Fernando Vincent's request to assist his cousin Laura Bittencourt Nanjo and children in leaving Japan for Brazil.
subfiles.from: Cecil M. P. Cross, American Consul General, São Paulo
subfiles.summary: Reports inquiry regarding exit permissions and Brazilian return for Laura Bittencourt Nanjo and her three children.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 58: Case of Laura Bittencourt Nanjo (Record Copy)

subfiles.about: State Department instruction outlining prerequisites for assisting Mrs. Nanjo and children in returning to Brazil.
subfiles.summary: Specifies conditions for repatriation from Japan, including security clearance, Brazilian government assent, and pre-arranged travel funds.
subfiles.title: Instruction to São Paulo Consulate General on Case of Laura Bittencourt Nanjo
subfiles.to: American Consular Officer in Charge, São Paulo

subfiles.about: Fragmentary internal routing slip concerning the Nanjo case file.
subfiles.summary: Brief routing slip attached to case papers.
subfiles.title: Routing Slip on Nanjo Case

subfiles.about: Original action copy of Despatch No. 58 concerning Fernando Vincent's inquiry regarding Laura Bittencourt Nanjo.
subfiles.from: Cecil M. P. Cross, American Consul General, São Paulo
subfiles.summary: Original action copy reporting inquiry regarding exit and Brazilian re-entry for Laura Bittencourt Nanjo and children.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 58: Case of Laura Bittencourt Nanjo (Action Copy)

subfiles.about: Record of discussions with Swiss diplomats regarding travel permits, exit visas, transit procedures, and SCAP supply policies in Tokyo.
subfiles.from: Hillis Lory, Division of Japanese Affairs
subfiles.summary: Summarizes discussion with Swiss representatives concerning travel permits, transit visa procedures, and SCAP policies on mission supplies.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Swiss Diplomatic Travel and Supplies

subfiles.about: Reporting Soviet press report in Izvestia protesting SCAP's refusal of an entry permit to a representative of the Moscow Patriarchate.
subfiles.from: Walter Bedell Smith, American Embassy, Moscow
subfiles.summary: Transmits Izvestia article criticizing SCAP for denying an entry permit to a Moscow Patriarchate representative and requesting an American bishop instead.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 216: Soviet Protest on Entry Refusal for Moscow Patriarchate
